scripts.dev: npm run db:deploy && npm --workspace apps/api run prisma:generate && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.db:migrate: npm --workspace apps/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: npm --workspace apps/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed: npm --workspace apps/api run prisma:generate && npm --workspace apps/api exec prisma db seed
